findings.text: `_NODE_HEAD_DIGITS-12`/`_NODE_HEAD_PATTERN` at scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:53-54 re-implement the node-id head-suffix parse that reckon/crew/repair.py:288 `_ROUND_HEAD_DIGITS` and `round_node_source` (reckon/crew/repair.py:310) already own; the census's own docstring names that writer/stripper pair, then re-derives it by regex instead of calling round_node_source, so the twelve-digit grammar lives in two places and can drift.

`_mounts` at scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:57 re-reads `~/.config/reckon/mounts.json` directly, duplicating the mounts reader the repository already owns (reckon/flight.py:484 `mounted_project_docs`, reckon/crew/query.py:359 `_mounted_projects`); a fourth copy of the same read is a drift risk on a file several modules resolve.

the unclassifiable branch (scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:168) carries no control: the run's stated controls exercise only the mismatched branch (a known positive) and the classified-negative branch, so the documented zero unclassifiable rows in docs/research/review-rows-with-another-rounds-verdict.html §4 is reported by a path the run never shows can fire.

justifications.durability: no test file was added and no assertion in the diff guards the classification, so a regression in _dispatched_head or _recorded_head would change the census figures with nothing reddening.
justifications.evidence: docs/research/review-rows-with-another-rounds-verdict.html §2 reconciles exactly with the recorded JSON at census-output.log (2339/18/0 across 11 projects), and a re-run reproduced the same 18 mismatched row ids and heads.
justifications.fit: the script follows the surrounding scripts/ idiom (module docstring, private helpers, a documented entry point) and introduces no name the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:99-190 walks every mounted project's runs directory and counts role==review rows whose recorded reviewed_head_sha does not begin with the dispatched head, which is the goal verbatim.
justifications.reuse: scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:54 duplicates the node-id head parse owned by reckon/crew/repair.py:310 round_node_source and scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:57 duplicates the shared mounts reader, though the .at- head path does extend the delivery predicate at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:133.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit 1ec00adbf503 changes exactly the three files named in the manifest's changed_paths, all inside the declared write paths, and touches no product source or shared plan state.
